name: Shakehand grip
description: Hold the racket like a handshake: thumb and index finger on the rubber, other fingers wrapped round the handle.

name: Penhold grip
description: Pinch the handle between thumb and index like a pen, with the other fingers curled behind the blade.

name: Forehand swing
description: Backswing, drive through the ball and follow through, keeping the grip steady.

name: Backhand swing
description: Bring the racket across your body and push through the ball with a compact stroke.

name: Wrist snap
description: Add a quick snap of the wrist at the moment of contact for extra spin and speed.

name: Serve toss pinch
description: Hold the ball between thumb and index finger and release it cleanly for the toss.

name: Single key press
description: Press one key with a curved finger, then lift.

name: Five-finger scale
description: Play five neighbouring keys up and back down, one finger per key.

name: C major chord
description: Press thumb, middle finger and little finger together to play C, E and G.

name: Pinch
description: Bring the thumb and index finger together, then release.

name: Power grip
description: Close all fingers firmly around an imaginary handle.

name: Point
description: Extend the index finger and curl the rest.

name: Spread
description: Open the hand flat with the fingers straight and apart.

name: Fist
description: Curl every finger into a loose fist.

name: Finger wave
description: Ripple the fingers one after another from thumb to little finger.
